item.title: arrow-detekt-rules - Catching Arrow Mistakes with detekt
item.description:
Arrow makes typed errors with Either and Raise a joy to work with, and a lot clearer than throwing exceptions around. There is more than one way to write it, though, and I have a style I want to stick to, like using ensure rather than an if statement with a raise.

As more and more code is written by agents, I wanted them to get early, automated feedback on that style, rather than me spotting it in review. So I built arrow-detekt-rules, a detekt 2 rule set for Arrow code. It flags places where a standard construct, like an if statement, has been used instead of the Arrow one, like ensure, along with a few mistakes the compiler is perfectly happy with that are quietly wrong.
